description: GET .../tables/{table}/@permissions (ReadTablePermissions) lists every user's table_perms grants on a single table -- the table-scoped analog of GET /dsns/{dsn}/@permissions, added so the dashboard's Table detail sheet can show a permissions list without needing ego.root (which the existing DSN-wide /dsns/{dsn}/tables/@permissions dump requires). A table name with no table_perms rows at all (never created, so it never received the creator's auto-grant either) must report an empty list, not an error or a null array
